title: 粒子加速器射頻腔~Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities
focus: 常溫銅射頻腔的模態、渡越時間、分路阻抗、耦合、失諧、束流負載與低階射頻穩定度~Mode, transit time, shunt impedance, coupling, detuning, beam loading and LLRF stability of normal-conducting copper RF cavities
summary: 以 500 MHz 級常溫銅射頻腔為主軸，從 TM010 模態與渡越時間因子推到銅壁損耗、分路阻抗與冷卻，再把輸入耦合器 β、網路分析儀與珠拉量測、熱失諧調諧、束流負載補償及速調管與低階射頻迴路整合成可交接的加速腔工程紀錄。~Built around a 500 MHz-class normal-conducting copper cavity, the course goes from the TM010 mode and transit-time factor to copper wall loss, shunt impedance and cooling, then integrates the input-coupler β, network-analyser and bead-pull measurements, thermal-detuning tuning, beam-loading compensation and the klystron plus LLRF loop into a transferable cavity engineering record.

units.anchor: TM010 腔體與軸向電場~TM010 cell and on-axis electric field
units.title: 柱形腔 TM010 模態與共振頻率~The pillbox TM010 mode and resonant frequency
units.mechanism: 射頻腔是把微波能量儲存在金屬空腔中的共振器，加速用的是 TM010 模態：電場沿束流軸向、在中心最大並沿半徑以貝索函數 J0 遞減，磁場沿方位角繞行並在側壁感應出表面電流。因為電場週期性反向，只有在電場指向前進方向的那半個週期穿過腔體的束團才會被加速，所以束團間距必須是射頻週期的整數倍。理想柱形腔的 TM010 頻率只由半徑決定，與長度無關；實際腔體加上鼻錐與束管後，頻率與場分布要用數值模擬修正。~An RF cavity is a resonator that stores microwave energy in a metal enclosure, and acceleration uses the TM010 mode: the electric field points along the beam axis, peaks at the centre and falls radially as the Bessel function J0, while the magnetic field circles azimuthally and drives surface currents in the side wall. Because the field reverses every half period, only bunches crossing the gap while the field points forward are accelerated, so bunch spacing must be an integer number of RF periods. In an ideal pillbox the TM010 frequency depends only on radius, not length; nose cones and beam pipes in a real cell shift frequency and field shape and must be corrected by numerical simulation.
units.model: 柱形腔 TM010 頻率 f = 2.405·c/(2πR)，2.405 是 J0 的第一個零點。R = 0.2255 m 時 f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz；改為 S 頻段 2998 MHz 只需 R ≈ 38.3 mm，因此頻率越高腔體越小、加工公差也越緊。~The pillbox TM010 frequency is f = 2.405·c/(2πR), where 2.405 is the first zero of J0. With R = 0.2255 m, f = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×0.2255) ≈ 508.9 MHz; an S-band 2998 MHz cell needs only R ≈ 38.3 mm, so higher frequency means smaller cavities and tighter machining tolerances.
units.verify: 以 2D 或 3D 電磁場本徵模求解器建模實際腔形，先對柱形腔解析解驗證網格收斂（誤差小於 0.1%），再與冷測時網路分析儀量到的 S21 共振峰比較；並以小天線沿軸掃描確認沒有把鄰近的 TM011 或 TE111 模態誤認為加速模。~Model the real cell shape with a 2D or 3D electromagnetic eigenmode solver, first checking mesh convergence against the analytic pillbox result to better than 0.1%, then compare with the S21 resonance measured on a network analyser during cold test; scan a small antenna along the axis to confirm that a neighbouring TM011 or TE111 mode has not been mistaken for the accelerating mode.
units.failure: 若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。~Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping.
units.misconception: 把柱形腔做得更長，TM010 的共振頻率就會下降。~Making a pillbox longer lowers its TM010 resonant frequency.

units.anchor: 加速間隙與同步相位~Accelerating gap and synchronous phase
units.title: 渡越時間因子與能量增益~Transit-time factor and energy gain
units.mechanism: 粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。間隙越長，粒子看到的場相位跨度越大，T 越小；但間隙太短又會提高表面電場並降低分路阻抗，鼻錐形狀就是在兩者間取捨。粒子相對射頻波峰的到達相位 φ 決定能量增益與縱向聚焦：直線加速器常在波峰附近運轉，儲存環則刻意偏離波峰以取得相位穩定。~A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T. A longer gap spans more RF phase and lowers T, while a very short gap raises the surface field and reduces shunt impedance, and nose-cone shaping is the compromise between the two. The arrival phase φ relative to the RF crest sets both energy gain and longitudinal focusing: linacs often run near crest, whereas storage rings deliberately run off crest to obtain phase stability.
units.model: 能量增益 ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ，柱形腔 T = sin x / x，x = πg/(βλ)。f = 508.9 MHz 時 λ = 0.589 m；β = 1、間隙 g = 0.20 m 得 x = 1.067、T ≈ 0.82；若 g = λ/2 = 0.295 m 則 T = 2/π ≈ 0.64，能量增益少了約 22%。~Energy gain is ΔW = q·V0·T·cosφ, and for a pillbox T = sin x / x with x = πg/(βλ). At f = 508.9 MHz, λ = 0.589 m; for β = 1 and a gap g = 0.20 m, x = 1.067 and T ≈ 0.82, while g = λ/2 = 0.295 m gives T = 2/π ≈ 0.64, about 22% less energy gain.
units.verify: 以模擬取得軸向電場 Ez(z)，用數值積分 ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz 計算有效電壓，並與 ∫|Ez|dz 比值得到 T；有束流後以能譜儀或束流位置在色散段的偏移量測能量增益對相位的掃描曲線，峰值應落在預期的 V0·T。~Take the on-axis field Ez(z) from simulation and evaluate the effective voltage ∫Ez(z)·cos(ωz/βc)dz numerically, dividing by ∫|Ez|dz to obtain T; with beam, scan energy gain against phase using a spectrometer or the beam position in a dispersive section, and check that the peak equals the expected V0·T.
units.failure: 把間隙電壓直接當成束流獲得的電壓，會高估能量增益約 20% 到 40%，造成下游磁鐵設定錯誤、軌道偏離，並讓儲存環的相位穩定區（射頻桶）比設計小。~Treating gap voltage as beam voltage overestimates energy gain by roughly 20% to 40%, which mis-sets downstream magnets, displaces the orbit and leaves a storage ring with a smaller RF bucket than designed.
units.misconception: 間隙越長，粒子在電場中停留越久，能量增益一定越大。~A longer gap always gives more energy gain because the particle spends longer in the field.

units.anchor: 無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道~Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels
units.title: 銅壁表面電阻、Q0 與分路阻抗~Copper surface resistance, Q0 and shunt impedance
units.mechanism: 射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。R/Q 只由腔形決定，代表單位儲能能產生多少加速電壓；分路阻抗 R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 則把腔形與材料損耗合在一起，決定維持某個電壓需要灌入多少瓦的銅損。這些熱量必須由嵌在腔壁的冷卻水道帶走，所以常溫腔設計同時是射頻問題也是熱工問題。~RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0. R/Q depends only on geometry and expresses how much accelerating voltage a given stored energy produces, while the shunt impedance R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 combines geometry with material loss and sets how many watts of copper loss are needed to hold a voltage. That heat must be carried away by water channels in the wall, so a normal-conducting cavity is a thermal design as much as an RF design.
units.model: Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ)，銅 σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m、f = 508.9 MHz 時趨膚深度約 2.9 µm、Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ；取幾何因子 G ≈ 200 Ω，Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴。若 R/Q = 150 Ω、Q0 = 3.3×10⁴，R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ，V = 0.6 MV 時 P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW；冷卻水溫升 5 K 需流量 ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s，約 210 L/min。~Rs = √(ωμ0/2σ); for copper with σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m at 508.9 MHz the skin depth is about 2.9 µm and Rs ≈ 5.9 mΩ, and with a geometry factor G ≈ 200 Ω, Q0 = G/Rs ≈ 3.4×10⁴. With R/Q = 150 Ω and Q0 = 3.3×10⁴, R_sh ≈ 5.0 MΩ and holding V = 0.6 MV costs P = V²/R_sh ≈ 72 kW; a 5 K water temperature rise needs ≈ 72000/(4186×5) ≈ 3.5 kg/s, about 210 L/min.
units.verify: 冷測時由網路分析儀量 Q0 並與 G/Rs 的理論值比較，比值通常落在 90% 到 95%，差距反映表面粗糙、硬焊接縫與氧化；高功率測試時以進出水溫差乘以流量做量熱，與 V²/R_sh 預測的銅損比對，兩者差異超過 5% 就要追查電壓刻度或熱損路徑。~During cold test measure Q0 with a network analyser and compare with the theoretical G/Rs, typically finding 90% to 95% of theory, the shortfall reflecting roughness, brazed joints and oxidation; at high power perform calorimetry from the water temperature rise times flow and compare with the V²/R_sh loss, chasing the voltage calibration or heat paths if they differ by more than 5%.
units.failure: 冷卻水道局部堵塞或流量分配不均，會在磁場最強的側壁形成熱點，局部膨脹使頻率漂移並造成表面疲勞裂紋，長期運轉後可能出現真空洩漏。~A partially blocked channel or poorly balanced flow creates a hot spot on the high-magnetic-field side wall, where local expansion drifts the frequency and cyclic stress cracks the surface, eventually leading to a vacuum leak after long operation.
units.misconception: R/Q 越高代表腔壁材料越好、損耗越低。~A higher R/Q means better wall material and lower loss.

units.anchor: 輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗~Input coupler and ceramic window
units.title: 輸入耦合器、耦合係數 β 與多重電子倍增~Input coupler, coupling factor β and multipacting
units.mechanism: 功率由波導或同軸線經耦合環或耦合孔送入腔體，耦合強度以 β = Q0/Q_ext 表示：β = 1 時無束流的腔體對源完全匹配，β > 1 為過耦合。真空與大氣之間由氧化鋁陶瓷窗隔開，窗面常鍍數奈米氮化鈦以降低二次電子發射係數。耦合器與窗是多重電子倍增最容易發生的地方：電子在 RF 場中來回撞擊表面，若二次電子產額大於 1 且飛行時間與射頻週期同步，電流就會雪崩式增加並加熱或擊穿窗片，因此新腔需要逐步升功率的老練。~Power enters through a waveguide or coaxial line via a coupling loop or iris, and the coupling strength is β = Q0/Q_ext: at β = 1 an unloaded cavity is perfectly matched to the source, and β > 1 is over-coupled. An alumina ceramic window separates vacuum from air, often coated with a few nanometres of titanium nitride to lower secondary-electron yield. Couplers and windows are where multipacting is most likely: electrons strike surfaces repeatedly in the RF field, and when the secondary yield exceeds one and the flight time is synchronous with the RF period, current avalanches and can heat or puncture the window, which is why a new cavity is conditioned by raising power in steps.
units.model: 無束流時反射係數 Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1)。若為了滿載束流把 β 設在 2.39，空載時 Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41，約 16.8% 的入射功率被反射；以銅損 72 kW 計，反射功率約 14.5 kW，必須由環形器與假負載吸收。~Without beam the reflection coefficient is Γ = (β − 1)/(β + 1). If β is set to 2.39 for full beam current, the empty cavity gives Γ = 1.39/3.39 ≈ 0.41 and reflects about 16.8% of the incident power; with 72 kW of wall loss the reflected power is about 14.5 kW, which a circulator and dummy load must absorb.
units.verify: 以網路分析儀在共振頻率量 S11 的大小與相位，於 Smith 圖上判斷過耦合或欠耦合並算出 β；老練時同時記錄真空壓力、窗溫紅外影像、電子拾取探針與反射功率，確認在每個功率階段沒有持續的多重電子倍增訊號才往上加功率。~Measure the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance with a network analyser and read over- or under-coupling from the Smith chart to compute β; during conditioning log vacuum pressure, infrared window temperature, electron-pickup probes and reflected power together, and raise power only when no persistent multipacting signature remains at each level.
units.failure: 窗片鍍層不足或老練過快時，多重電子倍增使窗片局部過熱產生熱應力裂紋，真空瞬間破壞並污染整個腔體與相鄰束管，需要長時間停機更換與重新烘烤。~With an inadequate window coating or overly fast conditioning, multipacting overheats the window locally until thermal stress cracks it, breaking vacuum and contaminating the cavity and adjacent beam pipe, forcing a long shutdown for replacement and rebake.
units.misconception: 耦合係數永遠應該設在 β = 1 才是最佳匹配。~The coupling factor should always be β = 1 for the best match.

units.anchor: 網路分析儀與珠拉台~Network analyser and bead-pull bench
units.title: 冷測：Q 值、β 與珠拉場分布量測~Cold test: Q, β and bead-pull field mapping
units.mechanism: 冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。場分布以珠拉法量測：把小金屬或介電珠沿軸拉過腔體，依 Slater 微擾理論，珠子所在處的電場平方正比於共振頻率位移，由此重建 Ez(z) 並計算 R/Q 與多腔結構的場平坦度。~Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext. The field profile is mapped by the bead-pull method: a small metal or dielectric bead is drawn along the axis and, by Slater perturbation theory, the square of the electric field at the bead is proportional to the resonant-frequency shift, from which Ez(z), R/Q and the field flatness of multi-cell structures are reconstructed.
units.model: 有載品質因數 Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB。量得 f0 = 500.00 MHz、Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz，得 Q_L ≈ 16 500；共振時 |S11| = 0.2 且由相位判定為過耦合，β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5，因此 Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300，外部品質因數 Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500。若誤判為欠耦合，β = 0.67、Q0 ≈ 27 500，差了三分之一。~The loaded quality factor is Q_L = f0/Δf_3dB. Measuring f0 = 500.00 MHz and Δf_3dB = 30.3 kHz gives Q_L ≈ 16 500; with |S11| = 0.2 at resonance identified from its phase as over-coupled, β = (1 + 0.2)/(1 − 0.2) = 1.5, so Q0 = Q_L(1 + β) ≈ 41 300 and the external quality factor is Q_ext = Q0/β ≈ 27 500. Misreading it as under-coupled gives β = 0.67 and Q0 ≈ 27 500, one third lower.
units.verify: 先以校正件做網路分析儀的完整雙埠校正並把參考面移到耦合器法蘭；珠拉時以已知尺寸的金屬珠在柱形校正腔中量出形狀因子，再量待測腔，並重複拉珠三次確認頻率位移的重現性與室溫漂移扣除後的殘差小於 1%。~Perform a full two-port calibration of the network analyser with standards and move the reference plane to the coupler flange; for bead pulls, determine the bead form factor with a known metal bead in a pillbox reference cavity before measuring the cavity under test, repeat each pull three times and confirm that the frequency-shift residual after subtracting room-temperature drift is below 1%.
units.failure: 未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。~Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand.
units.misconception: 網路分析儀上看到的頻寬直接就是腔體的 Q0。~The bandwidth seen on the network analyser directly gives the cavity Q0.

units.anchor: 柱塞調諧器與頻率預算~Plunger tuner and frequency budget
units.title: 加工公差、熱失諧與調諧範圍預算~Machining tolerance, thermal detuning and the tuning-range budget
units.mechanism: 腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。運轉中的頻率必須維持在有載頻寬的一小部分內，否則振幅與相位會隨失諧而改變。實務上用柱塞或壁面變形式調諧器補償，調諧範圍必須涵蓋製造殘差、熱漂移與束流負載所需的刻意失諧，並保留餘量。~Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away. In operation the frequency must stay within a small fraction of the loaded bandwidth, or amplitude and phase change with detuning. In practice a plunger or wall-deformation tuner compensates, and its range must cover fabrication residuals, thermal drift and the deliberate detuning required for beam loading, with margin.
units.model: 均勻尺度誤差 Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R：f = 508.9 MHz、R = 0.2255 m，半徑誤差 10 µm 即 Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz。銅 α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K，熱失諧 −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K；Q_L ≈ 9740 時半頻寬 f/(2Q_L) ≈ 26 kHz，冷卻水溫變化 0.5 K 造成 4.2 kHz 失諧，tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16，相位偏移約 9°。~For a uniform scale error Δf ≈ −f·ΔR/R: at f = 508.9 MHz and R = 0.2255 m a 10 µm radius error gives Δf ≈ −22.6 kHz. Copper has α = 16.5×10⁻⁶ /K, so thermal detuning is −f·α ≈ −8.4 kHz/K; with Q_L ≈ 9740 the half bandwidth f/(2Q_L) is about 26 kHz, and a 0.5 K water change detunes 4.2 kHz, giving tanψ = 2Q_L·Δf/f ≈ 0.16, a phase shift of about 9°.
units.verify: 在冷測台上逐步移動調諧器並記錄頻率，得到調諧曲線與遲滯；高功率時以入射與腔體探針的相位差作為失諧誤差訊號，觀察冷卻水溫階躍時調諧器是否在數秒內把相位拉回，並確認調諧器在最大熱負載與最大束流時仍留有至少 20% 行程。~On the cold-test bench step the tuner and log frequency to obtain the tuning curve and hysteresis; at high power use the phase between forward and cavity-probe signals as the detuning error, watch the tuner restore phase within seconds after a water-temperature step, and confirm at least 20% of travel remains at maximum heat load and beam current.
units.failure: 若調諧範圍只按冷態設計，滿功率時熱失諧加上束流負載所需的失諧把調諧器推到行程終點，腔體無法鎖頻，射頻系統只能降壓或跳脫。~If the tuning range is sized for the cold state only, thermal detuning at full power plus the detuning required by beam loading drive the tuner to its end stop, the cavity cannot be held on frequency, and the RF system must lower voltage or trip.
units.misconception: 腔體只要在冷測時調準頻率，運轉時就不需要再調。~Once tuned at cold test, a cavity needs no tuning in operation.

units.anchor: 束流電流與腔體失諧~Beam current and cavity detuning
units.title: 束流負載補償與最佳耦合~Beam-loading compensation and optimum coupling
units.mechanism: 高電流束流穿過腔體時會感應出自身的場，等效上是一個與腔電壓不同相的電流源，稱為束流負載。為了讓發電機只看到純電阻負載、沒有反射，需同時把耦合係數提高到 β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c，並把腔體刻意失諧以抵消束流電流的虛部。電流越大失諧越大，當失諧接近儲存環迴轉頻率時，加速模的阻抗會落在相鄰迴轉諧波上，引發縱向耦合束團不穩定；KEKB 的 ARES 腔以額外的大儲能腔降低有效 R/Q 來解決此問題。~A high-current beam passing through the cavity induces its own field, equivalent to a current source out of phase with the cavity voltage, which is called beam loading. To present the generator with a purely resistive load and no reflection, the coupling is raised to β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c and the cavity is deliberately detuned to cancel the reactive part of the beam current. The detuning grows with current, and when it approaches the ring revolution frequency the accelerating-mode impedance lands on neighbouring revolution harmonics and drives longitudinal coupled-bunch instability; the ARES cavity at KEKB attached a large storage cavity to lower the effective R/Q and solve this.
units.model: 設 V = 0.6 MV、R_sh = 5.0 MΩ、P_c = 72 kW，束流 I0 = 0.4 A、每腔能損 0.25 MV，P_b = 100 kW，β_opt = 2.39，Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740；cosφs = 0.25/0.6，sinφs ≈ 0.909，tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894，失諧 Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz（低於共振方向），發電機功率 P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW。~Take V = 0.6 MV, R_sh = 5.0 MΩ and P_c = 72 kW, with I0 = 0.4 A and 0.25 MV energy loss per cavity, so P_b = 100 kW, β_opt = 2.39 and Q_L = 3.3×10⁴/3.39 ≈ 9740; cosφs = 0.25/0.6 and sinφs ≈ 0.909 give tanψ = I0·R_sh·sinφs/((1+β)V) ≈ 0.894 and a detuning Δf = tanψ·f/(2Q_L) ≈ 23 kHz below resonance, with generator power P_g = P_c + P_b = 172 kW.
units.verify: 逐步增加儲存電流，記錄入射、反射功率、調諧器位置與腔體相位，與上式預測的失諧對電流曲線比較；以束流頻譜或縱向束團位置監測器觀察同步振盪邊帶，確認沒有在迴轉諧波上出現成長中的耦合束團模態。~Raise the stored current in steps while logging forward and reflected power, tuner position and cavity phase, and compare with the predicted detuning-versus-current curve; watch synchrotron sidebands on the beam spectrum or a longitudinal bunch-position monitor to confirm that no growing coupled-bunch mode appears at the revolution harmonics.
units.failure: 失諧方向設錯或束流電流超過 Robinson 穩定極限時，同步振盪振幅會快速成長，束流在數毫秒內丟失；β 固定在低電流值時，滿載下反射功率大增，環形器負載過熱跳機。~With the wrong detuning sign or a current beyond the Robinson stability limit, synchrotron oscillations grow quickly and the beam is lost within milliseconds; with β fixed at a low-current value, reflected power at full current overheats the circulator load and trips the system.
units.misconception: 束流只是吸收能量的負載，不會改變腔體的共振條件。~The beam only absorbs energy and never changes the cavity's resonance condition.

units.anchor: 速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF~Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF
units.title: 功率源、低階射頻控制與驗收交接~Power source, low-level RF control and acceptance handoff
units.mechanism: 射頻功率由速調管或模組化固態放大器提供，經波導、環形器與耦合器送入腔體；速調管單管可達百萬瓦但有高壓電源與陰極壽命問題，固態放大器以數百個電晶體模組合成，單模組失效只降低少量功率。低階射頻系統以數位 IQ 解調取樣腔體探針訊號，透過比例積分回授與前饋把振幅與相位鎖在設定值，並控制調諧器。驗收要同時證明場穩定度、跳機率、聯鎖反應與老練紀錄，而不只是達到額定電壓。~RF power comes from a klystron or a modular solid-state amplifier and flows through waveguide, circulator and coupler into the cavity; a single klystron reaches megawatts but brings a high-voltage modulator and cathode lifetime issues, while a solid-state amplifier combines hundreds of transistor modules so one module failure costs only a little power. The low-level RF system samples the cavity probe with digital IQ demodulation, locks amplitude and phase to setpoints with proportional-integral feedback and feed-forward, and drives the tuner. Acceptance must demonstrate field stability, trip rate, interlock response and conditioning history together, not merely rated voltage.
units.model: 能量增益 E = V·cosφ 的相對誤差 δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]。離峰 φ = 20°、振幅抖動 0.1%、相位抖動 0.1° = 1.745 mrad 時，tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴，總和 ≈ 1.18×10⁻³。迴路增益 G = 50 可把功率源 1% 漣波壓到約 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%。~The relative error of energy gain E = V·cosφ is δE/E = √[(δV/V)² + (tanφ·δφ)²]. Off crest at φ = 20° with 0.1% amplitude jitter and 0.1° = 1.745 mrad phase jitter, tanφ·δφ ≈ 0.364×1.745×10⁻³ ≈ 6.4×10⁻⁴ and the total is ≈ 1.18×10⁻³. A loop gain G = 50 suppresses a 1% source ripple to about 1%/(1+G) ≈ 0.02%.
units.verify: 以獨立的低相位雜訊參考與 IQ 量測鏈記錄閉迴路下振幅與相位的頻譜，積分到束流敏感的頻帶後與規格比較；以注入步階與調變檢查迴路頻寬、相位餘裕與延遲；最後在滿電流下連續運轉數十小時統計跳機次數與原因，連同老練曲線、聯鎖測試與冷測數據一起寫入交接文件。~Record closed-loop amplitude and phase spectra with an independent low-phase-noise reference and IQ measurement chain, integrate over the band the beam is sensitive to and compare with specification; check loop bandwidth, phase margin and delay with injected steps and modulation; finally run tens of hours at full current, tally trips by cause, and file them with conditioning curves, interlock tests and cold-test data in the handoff record.
units.failure: 迴路延遲過長卻把增益調得過高，回授在數百 kHz 處振盪，腔體場出現邊帶並調變束流；速調管工作在飽和區時沒有控制餘量，電源漣波直接傳到加速相位，表現為光束線光源點的時序與能量抖動。~Too much gain with too much loop delay makes the feedback oscillate at a few hundred kHz, putting sidebands on the cavity field that modulate the beam; a klystron driven into saturation leaves no control headroom, so modulator ripple passes straight into the accelerating phase and shows up as timing and energy jitter at the beamline source point.
units.misconception: 只要速調管輸出功率夠大，腔體場的穩定度自然就夠好。~If the klystron has enough output power, cavity field stability takes care of itself.

example: 500 MHz 儲存環常溫腔設計練習：TM010 半徑 R = 2.405c/(2πf) = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×5×10⁸) ≈ 0.2295 m。假設 R/Q = 145 Ω、Q0 = 3.5×10⁴，R_sh = 5.08 MΩ；腔壓 V = 0.55 MV 時銅損 P_c = V²/R_sh ≈ 59.6 kW。束流 I0 = 0.3 A、每腔能損 0.20 MV，P_b = 60 kW，最佳耦合 β_opt = 1 + 60/59.6 ≈ 2.01，Q_L = 3.5×10⁴/3.01 ≈ 11 600，半頻寬約 21.5 kHz。cosφs = 0.20/0.55 = 0.364、sinφs = 0.932，tanψ = 0.3×5.08×10⁶×0.932/(3.01×0.55×10⁶) ≈ 0.86，失諧 Δf ≈ 0.86×5×10⁸/(2×11 600) ≈ 18.4 kHz；發電機需 P_g ≈ 119.6 kW，加 25% 控制與波導餘量約 150 kW。空載時 Γ = 1.01/3.01 ≈ 0.33，約 11% 功率被反射。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Design exercise for a 500 MHz normal-conducting storage-ring cavity: the TM010 radius is R = 2.405c/(2πf) = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×5×10⁸) ≈ 0.2295 m. Assuming R/Q = 145 Ω and Q0 = 3.5×10⁴, R_sh = 5.08 MΩ, and a cavity voltage V = 0.55 MV costs P_c = V²/R_sh ≈ 59.6 kW. A beam of I0 = 0.3 A losing 0.20 MV per cavity takes P_b = 60 kW, so β_opt = 1 + 60/59.6 ≈ 2.01, Q_L = 3.5×10⁴/3.01 ≈ 11 600 and the half bandwidth is about 21.5 kHz. With cosφs = 0.20/0.55 = 0.364 and sinφs = 0.932, tanψ = 0.3×5.08×10⁶×0.932/(3.01×0.55×10⁶) ≈ 0.86 and the detuning is Δf ≈ 0.86×5×10⁸/(2×11 600) ≈ 18.4 kHz; the generator must supply P_g ≈ 119.6 kW, about 150 kW with 25% control and waveguide margin. Without beam Γ = 1.01/3.01 ≈ 0.33, so about 11% of the power is reflected. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
history: 1937 年 Varian 兄弟與 Hansen 在史丹佛發明速調管，提供了驅動微波共振腔的高功率源；1940 年代後期 Alvarez 在柏克萊建成漂移管直線加速器，W. Hansen 團隊則發展出行波電子直線加速器，最終促成 1966 年以 S 頻段速調管驅動的 SLAC 兩英里直線加速器。1990 年代 KEK 為 B 工廠的安培級束流研發 ARES 常溫腔，以加速腔—耦合腔—儲能腔三腔系統抑制束流負載造成的耦合束團不穩定，至今仍用於 SuperKEKB。~In 1937 the Varian brothers and Hansen at Stanford invented the klystron, supplying the high-power source that microwave resonators needed; in the late 1940s Alvarez built the drift-tube linac at Berkeley while Hansen's group developed the travelling-wave electron linac, leading to the two-mile SLAC linac driven by S-band klystrons in 1966. In the 1990s KEK developed the normal-conducting ARES cavity for ampere-class B-factory beams, using an accelerating, coupling and storage three-cavity system to suppress the coupled-bunch instability caused by beam loading, and it remains in use at SuperKEKB.

sources.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
sources.scope: 說明射頻腔如何以振盪電場加速並分群束流，以及 LHC 的 400 MHz 超導腔配置；為科普層級概述。
sources.scopeEn: Explains how RF cavities accelerate and bunch beams with oscillating fields and the LHC 400 MHz superconducting cavity layout; outreach-level overview.

sources.title: CERN 加速器學校：射頻腔設計講義（E. Jensen）
sources.titleEn: CERN Accelerator School: RF Cavity Design (E. Jensen, Chios 2011)
sources.scope: 涵蓋柱形腔 TM010、R/Q、分路阻抗、Q 值、等效電路與束流負載的講義；課程公式與慣例依此整理。
sources.scopeEn: Lecture covering the pillbox TM010 mode, R/Q, shunt impedance, Q, the equivalent circuit and beam loading; course formulas and conventions follow it.

sources.publisher: KEK High Energy Accelerator Research Organization

sources.scopeEn: Lists frequency, cavity voltage, wall loss, Q, R/Q and beam-loading detuning analysis for the ARES normal-conducting cavity; course values borrow only its orders of magnitude as teaching assumptions.

sources.scopeEn: Complete lecture collection on RF power generation and transport, cavity and coupler design, low-level RF electronics and beam diagnostics.
